title: 2008 AMC 12B Problem 6
statement: Postman Pete has a pedometer to count his steps. The pedometer records up to \(99999\) steps, then flips over to \(00000\) on the next step. Pete plans to determine his mileage for a year. On January \(1\) Pete sets the pedometer to \(00000.\) During the year, the pedometer flips from \(99999\) to \(00000\) forty-four times. On December \(31\) the pedometer reads \(50000.\) Pete takes \(1800\) steps per mile. Which of the following is closest to the number of miles Pete walked during the year?

solutions.text:
Each flip counts \(100000\) steps, so the year’s steps total \[ \begin{aligned} &44 \cdot 100000 \\ &\quad {}+ 50000 = 4{,}450{,}000. \end{aligned} \]

At \(1800\) steps per mile, the mileage is \(\dfrac{4{,}450{,}000}{1800} \approx 2472,\) which is closest to \(2500.\)

Thus, the correct answer is A.
hints: Each flip of the pedometer represents \(100000\) steps; add the final reading of \(50000\)
Divide the total number of steps by \(1800\) to convert to miles
